recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5919; future distinctions among source, recorder, and acceptance should be handled through the later Goal issue family rather than by restoring Goal.author.
issue_request: FHIR-5919 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking whether Goal could distinguish patient-stated goals and approving a motion to add Goal.author 0..1 as Reference(Patient, RelatedPerson, Practitioner).
initial_application: Git commit db4ace37c6 included #5919 and added Goal.author 0..1 Reference(Patient|Practitioner|RelatedPerson) in the DSTU-era Goal spreadsheet. That spreadsheet has since been superseded by the build-scoped Goal StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Later final decisions renamed the same concept from Goal.author to Goal.expressedBy (FHIR-9788), then to Goal.source while adding CareTeam (FHIR-28221), then added Group/family support (FHIR-41409), and later added Goal.recorder while explicitly keeping Goal.source (FHIR-48366). These changes explain why the current source does not contain the legacy Goal.author name.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/fhir.ini actively includes Goal and source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml defines Goal.source as 0..1 Reference with Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and later approved additional targets.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Goal.author to Goal.expressedBy because the element represented who.source rather than who.author.

Added Goal.recorder and explicitly chose no breaking change to Goal.source.
